purpose: Scientific and integrity checks for the SM-F7 conditional comparison; no production change
oracleScope: One exact-velocity and one nearest-admitted-coarse-motion local refinement per source, after blind outputs. Failures are not exhaustive.
runtimeScope: Fixed D,T4,T3,P3,P2.5 route order; warm timing plus separate common preparation. Whole-job memory is not per-route memory.
scientificLimits: Existing observations and fixed two-core domains, not new observing nights or full-field completeness
Native QC/seeing/ordinary tracks/streaks fixed; source photon noise omitted
Nominal aperture SNR is not calibrated magnitude or discovery confidence
Incomplete routes excluded from clean sensitivity comparisons; raw selected paths retained
Local oracle stage counts are conditional explanations, not independent gate ablations
productionTests: Not rerun: production source and libraries unchanged; diagnostic controls, exact library parity and real-data replay checks apply.
